title: Optimal Polynomial Tractability Exponents for the Inverse Star Discrepancy
summary: The inverse of the star discrepancy $n^\ast(d, \varepsilon)$ satisfies \[ d \varepsilon^{-1} \lesssim n^{\ast}(d,\varepsilon)\lesssim d\varepsilon^{-2} \] for all $d \in \mathbb{N}$ and $0 0$ and $\varepsilon_{α,A}>0$ such that, for every $0<\varepsilon<\varepsilon_{α,A}$ and every integer $d$ satisfying \[ A\varepsilon^{-α}\le d\le B\varepsilon^{-α}, \] one has \[ n^\ast(d,\varepsilon) \ge c_{α,B}\,d\,\varepsilon^{-(2-α)}. \] Along these polynomial strips the right-hand side is of order $\varepsilon^{-2}$.
